synthesizedPoints: Mapped Vipul's high-throughput data processing and cloud data architecture experience at Charter directly to Deloitte's Databricks Data Engineer requirements for modernizing enterprise platforms.
Integrated his hands-on background in Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL with the target role's core technical stack for building scalable data pipelines.
Bridged his experience in implementing dimensional models, Star/Snowflake schemas, and SCD patterns to satisfy Deloitte's need for advanced data integration and data modeling practices.

Highlighted his success in deploying automated data quality audit frameworks and ML-driven data reliability systems to fulfill client-facing delivery expectations for data governance and platform performance.
